review_method: Compared the observed behavior with git show of the pre-change TodoCreateSheet and the final source. The existing AI application and automatic-reminder logic remain unchanged.

observations.finding: AI suggests a task title and keeps the original request in the description
observations.evidence: The pre-change and final _breakDownTask both preserve originalInput in _descriptionCtrl, apply result.title only when !_titleManuallyChanged, and protect responses with the input revision.

observations.finding: AI date_time also arranges the task entry date
observations.evidence: Both baseline and final _buildDraft use date: useAiDate ? _aiDateTime! : draft.date. Manual deadline edits and clear only own dueDate; they do not change task entry date.

observations.finding: A future AI time can prefill a reminder even when the independent deadline was cleared
observations.disposition: Existing reminder behavior preserved; independent fields
observations.evidence: The baseline and final _syncAutomaticReminder are identical: return when _reminderManuallyChanged, otherwise use a recognised future wall time. Clearing dueDate does not claim or clear the reminder field. The browser confirmed dueDate remains null and the separate reminder can be disabled before saving.

result: No confirmed regression in the four requested changes. No runtime source changes after the final verified build.
